notes: The author asked for a cyberpunk city and then said outright that it is a walkable scene to explore and admire with no gameplay added, which is Entertainment's environment-demo case; the build exists to be looked at, so nothing here is won and no second genre is doing work. They also said a few high-density blocks presenting the streetscape and atmosphere, with no route prescribed, so I took Free-Roam Showcase on world-open rather than the guided Showcase path, and dropped the preset's hidden badges because collectibles are the extra gameplay they excluded. I added photo vignettes and the graphics-scaling set piece, since neon reflections, rain and dense signage are the atmosphere being asked for and isolating those clusters keeps a dense block affordable, plus settlement-density for the stated high-density blocks. With no user to ask I assumed street level only — no interiors, so no P3 — and no rooftop traversal, keeping this a single continuous exterior on P0; 'a few' blocks is not a firm count, so it stays in the wording.
